speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand the cause of your fatigue and itching, can you tell me if you have noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes, or changes in the color of your urine or stools?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis and these specific symptoms, I am concerned about primary sclerosing cholangitis. Do you currently experience any abdominal pain, particularly in the upper right side, or have you noticed a change in the color of your stools to pale or clay-like?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of scleral icterus and scratch marks confirms significant cholestasis, which, combined with your history of ulcerative colitis, strongly suggests Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis. To confirm this diagnosis and assess the extent of bile duct involvement, I will order specific imaging and blood work. REQUEST TEST: MRCP. REQUEST TEST: Antimitochondrial Antibody.
